item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 18/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. It will be hot with a few showers over the region. Besides, upper-air disturbances will bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China midweek this week. A trough of low pressure will form over central China in the latter part of this week, and will edge closer to the coast of southern China over the weekend.
